title: The Only Living Pickpocket in New York Rotten Tomatoes score? Above 92
rules: If The Only Living Pickpocket in New York has a Tomatometer score of above 92 on Nov 2, 2026 at 10:00 AM ET, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
The "Fresh!" and "Certified Fresh!" subtitles are meant for illustrative purposes only. The Tomatometer score must be above the strike value to resolve as YES (for example, a score of 75 would resolve "Above 75" as No.) The market will be determined the Monday after wide release at 10:00 AM ET.

This market and these products have not been endorsed by Rotten Tomatoes. Any references to Rotten Tomatoes or any associated marks are descriptive only and do not indicate an endorsement of this product or any affiliation between Rotten Tomatoes and Kalshi.

blind.reasoning: The film sits at 96% on 77 Rotten Tomatoes reviews (about 3 negative), with resolution on Nov 2, just after a modest Sony Pictures Classics nationwide expansion. To fall to 92% or below it would need roughly 5 or more negative reviews among perhaps 15-30 new ones. Recent reviews are a bit more mixed, but that would mean about a quarter of new reviews coming in negative. A small downward drift is likely, but probably not enough to break 93.
blind.falsifier: A wave of negative regional reviews during the wide-release weekend, pushing the count to about 8 or more negative reviews out of about 100 and the Tomatometer to 92% or lower by Nov 2.

final.reasoning: The market's 0.89 midpoint sits slightly above my estimate, but the cushion at 96% on 77 reviews is real, and the edge on a NO bet at the 0.87 bid is too small given uncertainty about how many and how negative the new reviews will be. I nudged my estimate up slightly and am passing.
